name: corvus
description: Reverse engineering and security analysis of .NET assemblies and native binaries: decompile, search, compare builds, patch and save.
long_description: Reads .NET assemblies and native PE, ELF and Mach-O binaries without running them: C#, IL, disassembly, cross-references, call graphs, build comparison, containers and crash dumps. Edits stay in memory until saved to a new file.

profile.title: Tool profile
profile.description: full (every tool), core (the main families) or lean (the 40 most used tools).
